name: Qdrant

repo.name: qdrant
repo.description: Qdrant - High-performance, massive-scale Vector Database and Vector Search Engine for the next generation of AI. Also available in the cloud https://cloud.qdrant.io/

node_fit.hypothesis: Qdrant can power dedicated semantic memory and retrieval services for Context, Radar, and Learning nodes.

evidence.note: Repository metadata shows active pushes, Apache-2.0 license, recent v1.18.2 release, and vector database topics.

risks: Requires service deployment or cloud dependency.
Needs realistic retrieval benchmark before approval.
Operational overhead may be too high for small local-only node runs.
next_review_tasks: Test local Docker or binary setup.
Benchmark retrieval for concept notes and node artifacts.
Document when Qdrant is preferable to pgvector or embedded stores.
